item: Home cards: an interpolated date keeps its order under Arabic (RTL item 22)
refs: PR #1498; release gate 0.5 section 1d item 22; audit 0.5.0 follow-on
summary: The encrypted click-through reported an ISO date drawn reordered under Arabic; re-run on a PLAINTEXT store it reproduces, so it is a product defect, not an encryption one. The node is a Home briefing card sentence (recycled_claim) that interpolates a date into a translated frame, not the Home date tile: after an Arabic letter the digits take the Arabic-number class (W2) and the hyphen is no longer joined, so 2025-12-14 was drawn 14-12-2025. _cardFrameVars, the one point every keyed card frame passes through, now wraps each data var that is not a number, a translated word or a month-day in U+2068..U+2069 when the document is right-to-left. Numbers still go through fmtNum unisolated and left-to-right text is byte-identical; both pinned on the real Arabic key in tests/card_frames_node_test.js (red without the change). Stated limit: the other raw slice(0,10) date sites (app-home feed meta lines, about 40 in app-analysis, app-corpus, app-claim) are not changed; their sweep is 0.5.1 item 46.
